summary: Christian Watson anytime TD has upgraded from PASS at +140 to BET_NOW at DraftKings +150. The price improved while new independent probability evidence from Stats Insider assigns Watson a 49.7% anytime-TD probability. PRIME discounts that single-model estimate to a conservative 47.0% fair probability because touchdown markets are high variance and other books price Watson shorter. DraftKings +150 implies 40.0%, leaving a 7.0 percentage-point internal edge (6-8% bucket). The football context is supportive: Jayden Reed remained DNP Tuesday, A.J. Terrell is on IR, Watson has a concentrated Week 2 role, and Jordan Love told reporters his elbow discomfort is a non-issue for Thursday. Recommend 0.5u at +150, playable to +135 or better. Do not stack correlated Green Bay passing/receiving overs solely from the same thesis.
